## Summary

Describe the user problem and the focused change.

## Safety and privacy impact

- Does this change research, broker reads, shadow mode, supervised orders, or autonomous authority?
- Does it add an external connection, persisted data, credential scope, or user-visible risk?
- If none, write `None`.

## Verification

- [ ] `./verify.ps1` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests.
- [ ] No test connects to a live broker or places an order.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] UI changes were checked at relevant portrait and landscape sizes.
- [ ] Screenshots and diagnostics are redacted.
- [ ] No generated files, credentials, account data, receipts, licensed data, or local databases are included.

## Evidence

List source checks and any safe manual checks. Do not include secrets or live account information.
